1532496.title: Add ipv6 PBR with View IP Version IPV6 only
1532496.result: 1.The type is ipv6 and all and only ipv6 Address/Subnet are available in Source/Destination selection list.2.All and only ipv6 addresses are available in Gateway selection.3.An ipv6 PBR route can be successfully added in this way.
